Name: ✦ Haunt
Description: <light_purple>It doesn't chase in a straight line. It doesn't need to.
- Small, relentless <red><bold>Damage</bold> <reset>strikes that keep growing every 7 levels, right up to level 99
- A phasing <blue><bold>Sprint</bold> <reset>burst that never really stops
- A padded <red><bold>Life</bold> <reset>pool — it plans on being hit and not caring

Notifications.20: <light_purple>It phases through the wall before you finish turning — Haunt has arrived.
